From 5651e5e094591f479adad5830ac1bc45196a39b3 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Eric Anholt <eric@anholt.net>
Date: Fri, 9 Mar 2018 15:33:32 -0800
Subject: [PATCH] drm/panel: simple: Fix the bus format for the Ontat panel

This fixes bad color output.  When I was first testing the device I
had the DPI hardware set to 666 mode, but apparently in the refactor
to use the bus_format information from the panel driver, I failed to
actually update the panel.

Signed-off-by: Eric Anholt <eric@anholt.net>
Fixes: e8b6f561b2ee ("drm/panel: simple: Add the 7" DPI panel from Adafruit")
Cc: Thierry Reding <thierry.reding@gmail.com>
Signed-off-by: Thierry Reding <treding@nvidia.com>
Link: https://patchwork.freedesktop.org/patch/msgid/20180309233332.1769-1-eric@anholt.net

diff --git a/drivers/gpu/drm/panel/panel-simple.c b/drivers/gpu/drm/panel/panel-simple.c
index 5591984a392b..f9649bded63f 100644
--- a/drivers/gpu/drm/panel/panel-simple.c
+++ b/drivers/gpu/drm/panel/panel-simple.c
@@ -1597,7 +1597,7 @@ static const struct panel_desc ontat_yx700wv03 = {
 		.width = 154,
 		.height = 83,
 	},
-	.bus_format = MEDIA_BUS_FMT_RGB888_1X24,
+	.bus_format = MEDIA_BUS_FMT_RGB666_1X18,
 };
 
 static const struct drm_display_mode ortustech_com43h4m85ulc_mode  = {
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `drivers/gpu/drm/panel/panel-simple.c`**
   - The `bus_format` for the `ontat_yx700wv03` panel descriptor was changed from `MEDIA_BUS_FMT_RGB888_1X24` to `MEDIA_BUS_FMT_RGB666_1X18`. This modification addresses an issue with bad color output by correctly setting the bus format for the Ontat panel.

### Relationships Between Modifications

- The change in the `bus_format` is directly related to fixing the color output issue that arose from a previous refactor. The original setting was incorrect for the panel, and this patch corrects it to ensure proper functionality. The modification is a response to the identified bug linked to the earlier commit (`e8b6f561b2ee`), which introduced the panel but did not update the bus format accordingly.
